sources.entry: SuperDuper! - Painless fully bootable disk backups.

summary.name: SuperDuper! Classic
summary.one_liner: SuperDuper! Classic is a macOS disk-cloning tool that makes fully bootable HFS+ or APFS backups of a Mac's startup disk to a separate destination drive.
use_cases: Making a bootable clone of a Mac startup disk
Recovering a Mac from a full system backup
Backing up an older Mac running High Sierra through Tahoe
Keeping a bootable copy alongside Time Machine backups
Copying APFS snapshots to a drive for point-in-time backups
summary.what_it_does: The current Classic release (3.12) supports macOS 10.13 High Sierra through Tahoe (macOS 26) and is Apple silicon native. It makes fully bootable backups on HFS+ or APFS volumes, copying only changed data on later runs via Smart Update. Smart Wake runs backups whether the Mac is awake or asleep, and Smart Delete aims to avoid "disk full" errors. It can create and copy from APFS snapshots, and it can work alongside Time Machine, including copying an HFS+ Time Machine disk to a larger drive. Scheduling, AppleScript support and Dark Mode are included, and older macOS versions are served by earlier SuperDuper! releases listed on the page.
notable: Bootable HFS+ and APFS clones, Apple silicon native
Smart Update copies only changed data to keep clones current
Older versions (back to Jaguar 10.2) available for legacy Macs
Works alongside Time Machine and can copy APFS snapshots
caveats: Requires a destination drive separate from the startup disk; CDs, DVDs and tape are not supported
Versions before v3.12 have documented security issues, according to the page
USB drives cannot boot PowerPC Macs due to a macOS limitation
